name: MERCURIUS DULCIS
key_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting of infants (Cup ars; Iris).
guiding_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting of infants (Cup ars; Iris).
head_symptoms: Otitis media; closure of Eustachian tube; ear troubles of scrofulous children; membrana tympani retracted, thickened and immovable.
gi_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting of infants (Cup ars; Iris).
skin_symptoms: Flabby and ill nourished. Swollen glands. Phagedenic ulcers. Copper-colored eruptions.

source.title: MERCURIUS DULCIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
